readings.Aries: The wound you keep reopening has something to teach. You've been treating the symptom. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Taurus: You process change slowly and completely. The speed is not a flaw; the resistance is sometimes. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Gemini: You're very good at making things feel lighter. Someone around you needs weight acknowledged, not lifted. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Cancer: The dream you're not taking seriously is the dream you should take seriously. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Leo: There is love in your life that is asking to be expressed more plainly. Try plain. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Virgo: The system you've built is working. You are allowed to stop improving it for one day. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: Someone is asking you to take their side. You are stalling. At some point stalling is a choice. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Scorpio: You are in a period of accumulating rather than expending. What you're gathering will matter. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Sagittarius: You are drawn to the idea of a thing more than the thing itself. Make sure this one is different. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Capricorn: You have been faithful to something for a long time. It has been faithful to you. Notice this. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Aquarius: The thing you're resisting because it seems too normal — normal isn't the problem. Examine the actual resistance. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Pisces: Your perception of what someone needs is often more accurate than their perception of what they need. Use this gently. The question matters more than the answer right now.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
